title: 情報工学基礎演習
subtitle: Computer Programming Practice
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn basic management and operational skills for computer systems. (2) Acquire various C programming skills on Linux command line. (3) Acquire Linux environment construction and operation technology.
advice: This is a basic C programming course. We will cover the following materials: 1. Installing virtual machines and Linux 2. Linux command exercises 3. Programming with the basic data types and array 4. Standard input/output stream 5. Programming with the function definitions and its calls 6. Recursive function call 7. Programming with the structure and pointer 8. String processing 9. File input/output processing 10. Programming with the bitwise logical operators Students are expected to bring their textbook, notebook PC, and other necessary materials to every class. Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and on a regular basis.
books: Textbooks:C language for beginners(ISBN 978-4-407-32089-3, Japaneses Version Only) Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: This course requires the following knowledge/skills: 1. The units of “Programming 1” and “Programming 2” have been acquired. 2. Knowledge of basic logical operation. 3. Basic computer programming skills.

activityGoals.body: Be able to manage programming, debugging, and execution.
Be able to create a program with appropriate combinations of functions, pointers, structures, etc.
Be able to verify that the program is executing correctly.

    授業科目の学習・教育目標   キーワード 学習・教育目標     1.Linux 2.C 3.Pointer 4.Structure 5.File input/output  Students will: (1) Learn basic management and operational skills for computer systems. (2) Acquire various C programming skills on Linux command line. (3) Acquire Linux environment construction and operation technology.
    授業の概要および学習上の助言   This is a basic C programming course. We will cover the following materials: 1. Installing virtual machines and Linux 2. Linux command exercises 3. Programming with the basic data types and array 4. Standard input/output stream 5. Programming with the function definitions and its calls 6. Recursive function call 7. Programming with the structure and pointer 8. String processing 9. File input/output processing 10. Programming with the bitwise logical operators Students are expected to bring their textbook, notebook PC, and other necessary materials to every class. Students are expected to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class and on a regular basis.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
